name: handily-tests
description: A tests tab that lists each failed test by name with its file, line and assertion diff, read from the vitest, jest, node --test or pytest output of a Bash call. /tests opens it.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: failures: the status line shows the last test run while it failed. always: it also shows a pass and a run in progress. off: the mod sets no status line.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: on: a toast when a test run turns from pass to fail and when it passes again, while the tests tab is not shown. off: no toast for a run.
